scientific_queries.note: Permutation test of the drug-to-pathway mapping on the strongest claim.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round adds the one control the strongest claim was missing and the within-dataset case closes.

what_this_establishes.the_missing_check: a random block controls capacity but is white noise, so it cannot separate 'any structured block of this width helps' from 'this mapping helps'
what_this_establishes.result: the permuted block behaves exactly like the random one while the real-minus-permuted contrast is significant in both pools
what_this_establishes.reading: the gain comes from the specific drug-pathway assignment

the_full_case_for_the_claim.direction: eight independent split sets, all positive and significant
the_full_case_for_the_claim.capacity: a matched random block is never significant
the_full_case_for_the_claim.structure: a permuted block of the same width is never significant, and real minus permuted is significant
the_full_case_for_the_claim.condition: present only when both drugs are unseen
the_full_case_for_the_claim.internal_control: the tissue block delivers exactly zero when its columns are absent

what_this_means_for_promotion.within_dataset: exhausted: direction, capacity, structure, condition and the dead-block control have all been run
what_this_means_for_promotion.remaining_blocker: only the missing second dataset, which C78 and C89 established cannot be built from BATCHIE across three arenas and three units
what_this_means_for_promotion.honest_status: the claim is as well supported as this machine allows and still not promotable, because the rule requires cross-dataset replication and no usable second resource exists
what_this_means_for_promotion.distinction: this is a resource limit, not an evidence limit, and the two must be stated separately

limits: permutation preserves the marginal distribution but not every structural property of the block
dense criterion only, a quartile rather than a clinical endpoint
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: freeze this conditional claim in the synthesis, note explicitly what would unfreeze it (a second resource that is neither saturated nor a training source), and move on
